name: hush
description: Hush: a cross-browser MV3 extension that hides posts containing words you choose, plus the self-hosted Household Hub that manages it.
author: Emmanuel Janssens
//: Additions to the starter-kit package.json: description/license/author kept from the extension package.
test also runs ext:test so one command covers hub and extension.
ext:* scripts run the extension in src/ (outside the pnpm workspace, no dependencies; ext:test works before pnpm install).
No "type" field: the extension tests in test/ are CommonJS.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter contracts build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter api --filter web dev
scripts.test: pnpm --filter contracts build && pnpm -r test && pnpm ext:test
scripts.ext:sign: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && npx --yes web-ext sign --source-dir src --channel=unlisted --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts
